scenes.vo: Every morning, there's one more pair of shoes outside my door.
scenes.cap: Every morning: one more pair of shoes outside my door

scenes.vo: Monday, one pair of slippers. Not mine. I left them for the owner.
scenes.cap: Monday: one pair of slippers. Not mine.

scenes.vo: Tuesday, two pairs. Wednesday, three. Nobody in the building has claimed them.
By Sunday there were seven. All my size. All a little muddy, like someone had been walking around in them.
scenes.cap: Sunday: 7 pairs. All my size. All slightly muddy.

scenes.vo: Last night I lined them up to count. Seven pairs outside. But my own shoes, by the bed, were gone.
scenes.cap: Last night I counted. Seven outside. My own shoes: gone.

scenes.vo: Now it's three in the morning. I'm barefoot. And in the kitchen, I can hear footsteps. In shoes.
scenes.cap: 3 AM. I'm barefoot. In the kitchen: footsteps. In shoes.

scenes.vo: Tomorrow morning, I think there'll be one more pair outside my door.
scenes.cap: Tomorrow: one more pair outside my door?
